body.purpose: Owner entries and static export text.

motion.name: bookmarks
motion.purpose: Background and inset edge response; removed for reduced motion.

motion.name: checkbox
motion.purpose: Checked background and inset shadow; removed for reduced motion.

components.name: Bound paper
components.description: Open writing paper with the shared ochre binding.
components.html:
Morning

A little intention for the day ahead.
components.css: .ds-paper{padding:25px 32px 25px 44px;background:var(--slop-paper, #faf6ec);color:var(--slop-ink, #2a241c);box-shadow:inset 14px 0 0 var(--slop-morning-accent, #ba843b),inset 17px 0 7px -5px rgba(78,53,25,.24);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;}.ds-paper h2{margin:0;font-family:"Journal Lora", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;font-size:36px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.03em}.ds-paper p{font-size:14px;color:var(--slop-muted, #726554)}

components.name: Period bookmarks
components.description: Morning and Evening share the bookmark form; Day uses an underline.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" aria-label="Journal view"><button class="ds-tab" aria-current="page">Morning</button><button class="ds-tab">Evening</button><button class="ds-day">Day</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:9px;background:var(--slop-paper, #faf6ec);padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--slop-rule, color-mix(in srgb, var(--slop-ink) 14%, transparent))}.ds-tab,.ds-day{min-height:46px;border:0;border-radius:7px 7px 0 0;padding:8px 12px;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;background:var(--slop-surface, #f1eadc);color:var(--slop-muted, #726554);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease,box-shadow 160ms ease}.ds-tab[aria-current]{background:var(--slop-morning-deep, #eed7a7);color:var(--slop-morning-ink, #6b4a12);box-shadow:inset 0 3px 0 var(--slop-morning-accent, #ba843b)}.ds-day{background:transparent}.ds-tab:hover:not([aria-current]),.ds-day:hover{background:var(--slop-morning, #f7ead0)}.ds-tab:focus-visible,.ds-day:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--slop-evening-accent, #475d73);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tab,.ds-day{transition:none}}

components.name: Writing line
components.description: A growing textarea on one fine rule; Lora uses its fallback when the preview has not loaded the bundled font.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">I am grateful for…<textarea class="ds-field" rows="1" placeholder="A small comfort…"></textarea></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label{display:block;padding:12px;background:var(--slop-paper, #faf6ec);color:var(--slop-ink, #2a241c);font-family:"Journal Lora", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:500;line-height:23px}.ds-field{display:block;width:100%;min-height:23px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--slop-rule, color-mix(in srgb, var(--slop-ink) 14%, transparent));border-radius:0;padding:11px 0 10px;resize:none;field-sizing:content;overflow:hidden;background:transparent;color:var(--slop-ink, #2a241c);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:23px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-field::placeholder{color:var(--slop-dim, #796c5b);opacity:1;font-size:14px}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--slop-morning-ink, #6b4a12)}

components.name: Written toggle
components.description: Manual completion with a labeled checkbox.
components.css: .ds-written{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-height:44px;padding:6px 0;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:var(--slop-morning-ink, #6b4a12);cursor:pointer}.ds-written input{appearance:none;width:21px;height:21px;margin:0;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:3px;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms ease,box-shadow 180ms ease}.ds-written input:checked{background:var(--slop-morning-deep, #eed7a7);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgba(78,53,25,.15)}.ds-written input:checked::after{content:"";display:block;width:9px;height:5px;border-left:2px solid currentColor;border-bottom:2px solid currentColor;transform:translate(4px,5px) rotate(-45deg)}.ds-written:hover{color:var(--slop-ink, #2a241c)}.ds-written input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--slop-evening-accent, #475d73);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-written input{transition:none}}

components.name: Calendar day
components.description: Selected calendar day, with a visible keyboard focus state.
components.css: .ds-calendar-day{width:44px;height:44px;border:0;border-radius:5px;padding:0;background:var(--slop-morning-ink, #6b4a12);color:var(--slop-paper, #faf6ec);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;cursor:pointer}.ds-calendar-day:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--slop-evening-accent, #475d73);outline-offset:3px;outline-offset:-2px}

components.name: Calendar overlay
components.description: Warm paper overlay with ambient depth.
components.css: .ds-calendar{width:280px;padding:12px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--slop-paper, #faf6ec);color:var(--slop-ink, #2a241c);box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(51,38,22,.24);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;}.ds-calendar h3{font-family:"Journal Lora", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:500;margin:0 0 8px}.ds-calendar button{width:100%;min-height:44px;margin-top:8px;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--slop-rule, color-mix(in srgb, var(--slop-ink) 14%, transparent));background:transparent;color:var(--slop-morning-ink, #6b4a12);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer}.ds-calendar button:hover{background:var(--slop-morning, #f7ead0)}.ds-calendar button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--slop-evening-accent, #475d73);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
An ivory daybook with an ochre binding and two colored bookmarks. Serif prompts give the writing a quiet, personal voice; generous ruled fields leave the page open for the owner’s words.

The material belongs to Five Minute Journal. Familiar tabs, a calendar, and a manual checkbox make the object understandable without learning a metaphor.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and an ochre binding frame the writing.
Morning and Evening have distinct bookmarks, words, and sun or moon marks.
Growing fields, visible focus, and restrained state transitions support unhurried use.

rules.name: The Period Rule
rules.body: Pair each period’s color with its name and sun or moon mark.

rules.name: The Writing Rule
rules.body: Set prompts in Lora and the owner’s writing in the readable sans-serif body face.

rules.name: The Binding Rule
rules.body: Keep material depth at the book edge and temporary overlays; writing stays on one open paper surface.

dos: Do keep the warm paper, ochre binding, and two bookmark colors recognizable across editor, export, and icon.
Do let writing wrap and grow while keeping labels and focus visible.
Do preserve the public theme token names when refining the palette.
donts: Don’t turn written status into a score or infer it from filled fields.
Don’t use placeholder suggestions as saved journal entries.
Don’t copy this daybook’s palette into other slops as a collection theme.
